subject: Mining
examFormat: Two papers, both taken as a composite paper in one sitting of 2 hours 45 minutes. Paper 1: forty multiple choice objective questions in 40 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 2: Section A has 10 short structured questions covering the entire syllabus, all answered in 40 minutes for 40 marks; Section B has five essay-type questions of which any three are answered in 1 hour 25 minutes for 60 marks. Field work forms 40 percent of the continuous assessment scores forwarded to the examining body.
excluded: Field work notes (continuous assessment), list of facilities/equipment and suggested reading list, as non-topic material.

topics.name: Introduction to Mining
objectives: Explain the meaning and branches of mining
Use the terminology used in mining
Classify minerals and state their importance
Describe the distribution of minerals in Nigeria
Describe the history of mining
Describe mining activities in Nigeria
State the importance of minerals to man and the national economy
Explain minerals markets and cartels
Explain mine accounting and sources of finance for mining ventures
Describe aspects of the Nigerian Minerals and Mining Act, 2007
Describe mining titles acquisition

topics.name: Basic Geology
objectives: Define geology and its scope
Explain the relationship between geology and mining
Describe the structure of the Earth
State the relative abundance of elements in the Earth's crust
Describe the economic mineral potentials of Nigeria
Describe rocks and rock types (igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic)
Identify rock-forming minerals
State the physical and chemical properties of rock-forming minerals
Explain the rock cycle
Explain weathering
Use a simplified geological map of Nigeria
Use a mineral map of Nigeria
Collect and collate geological data
Interpret topographical and geological maps
Draw a simple geological cross-section

topics.name: Stages of Development in Mining (Basic Concepts)
objectives: Classify mining methods into surface and underground mining methods
Explain the reasons for choosing surface or underground mining methods
Describe surface mining methods: quarrying, open pit mining, open cast mining, alluvial mining etc
Describe underground mining methods: room-and-pillar, longwall, cut-and-fill, shrinkage, block caving, sub-level etc
Compare surface and underground mining methods
Justify the choice of methods
Explain the prospecting stage and outline prospecting techniques (geological, geophysical, geochemical, remote sensing)
Explain the exploration stage and classify exploration techniques (geological, geophysical, geochemical, remote sensing)
Explain the feasibility study of a mining venture
Describe financial analysis in mining
Explain a mine, mine development, mineral processing design, mill design and mining as actual exploitation, and list unit operations in mining, e.g. drilling and blasting
State the need for and economic benefits of mineral processing and list unit operations in mineral processing
Explain the meaning and processes of metal extraction, e.g. smelting (pyrometallurgy), hydrometallurgy and electrometallurgy

subtopics.name: Surface Mining Methods
objectives: Describe the open pit as an example of surface mines, its features and the minerals mined by the open pit method
Describe the open cast mine as an example of surface mine, its features and the minerals mined by the open cast method
Explain quarrying and dimension stones production: meaning, products of quarrying, uses of products, unit operations of a quarry and flow sheet of the operations of a quarry
Describe dimension stone production

subtopics.name: Underground Mining Methods
objectives: Describe the features of an underground mine
Explain the basic concepts of underground mining methods, e.g. square setting, cut-and-fill, shrinkage, sub-level, long-hole, open long-hole, block-caving, open-cut

subtopics.name: Other Mining Methods and Materials Handling
objectives: Describe sea-floor mining
Describe moon and asteroid mining
Identify materials handling equipment, e.g. conveyor belt, trucks, pay-loader

topics.name: Introduction to Mineral Processing
objectives: Explain mineral processing, comminution terms, concentration terms and mill accounting terms
State the properties of minerals employed in mineral processing, e.g. specific gravity, magnetism
Describe the main operations in mineral processing: comminution and concentration
Describe the products of mineral processing, e.g. concentrate and tailings, middling (intermediate product), dewatering in mineral processing, auxiliary operations and tailings disposal

topics.name: Gemology and Lapidary
objectives: Explain the meaning of gemology and lapidary
Identify machines and tools in gemstone processing, e.g. faceting machine, grinding machine, polishing machine
Explain the meaning and properties of gemstones
Identify types of gemstones based on shape, colour, size, refractive index etc.
Describe the characteristics and methods of identification of gemstones and the quality of gemstones
State the units of measurement of gemstones and the prices of gemstones
Describe the marketing and prices of gemstones

topics.name: Health, Safety and Environment
objectives: Identify health hazards in mining
State safety requirements/measures in mining
Describe the impacts of mining on the environment
Identify safety equipment and apparels used in mining, including personal protective equipment (PPE)
Identify common diseases associated with the mining industry
Administer simple first aid, drugs and dressing material
State guidelines for accident reporting and steps for environmental control
Explain basic issues in the National policy on mineral development
State mining laws and regulations
State environmental protection laws
Explain the National policy on the environment
